## Landscape Overview (10 systems):
- **corp.itsm**: ITSM system with agents for incident management, root cause analysis, change coordination, safety incidents, and asset provisioning (NO retrieval APIs)
- **sap.crm**: CRM system with agents for opportunity management, sales coordination, and campaign optimization
- **sap.s4**: ERP system with procurement, BOM, sales, and change orchestration agents; ProcurementMatchingAgent for cost/vendor analysis
- **sap.sf**: HR/HCM system (SuccessFactors) with EmployeeCompensationManagement API and compensation automation agents
- **sap.ariba**: Procurement system with PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI (supplier POs), SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI, invoice matching, sourcing, compliance APIs; SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor for hazmat tracking
- **sap.ehs**: Safety/compliance system with risk identification, incident analysis, and compliance automation agents (ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator for compliance risk ID)
- **workday.hcm**: HCM system with compensation adjustment/change processors
- **siemens.plm**: PLM system with BOM compliance and engineering change agents (BOMComplianceValidator, EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning)
- **my.mes**: MES system with production quality, supplier compliance, change orchestration, BOM validation, and hazmat compliance agents
- **sap.odm**: Data model (entity types only, not resources)

## Deployment & Scheduling:
- **my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1** - Orchestrates production changes with scheduling/sequencing capabilities (schedule-machines, sequence-work-orders, orchestrate-production-execution)
- Follows naturally from engineering change provisioning in PLM step
- Handles rollout timeline and deployment schedule tracking through production orchestration

- Field communication platforms
- Team collaboration/status update mechanisms
